declaration.evidence_label: E-MAX DEVELOPMENT (reused development data; not OOS)
declaration.question: With R1 / max 3 fixed, does raising exposure to 1.5x on high-breadth sessions only improve on constant 1.0x?

dataset.binding: the E-R2 / E-R3 / M1 / M2 development binding, unchanged (480 sessions 2024-10-16..2026-09-16)
dataset.prechecks: re-run through app.backtest.strategy_e_max.prepare before any return

variants.h5_rate: H5 candidate count / 09:25 PIT universe rows (both sealed at 09:25)
variants.implementation: app.strategy_e_max.breadth (multiplier, scale); B1 through app.strategy_e_max.capacity.execute at capacity 3, as M2's C1
forbidden: breadth as a trade filter (no trade is added or removed)
changes to R1, capacity, H5, entry, exit, stop, target or cost

exposure_semantics.scaling: every position weight and every scenario session return of a high-breadth session is multiplied by 1.5; B2 high-breadth session return = 1.5 x B1 session return exactly, costs included
exposure_semantics.financing: NOT MODELED (margin interest, broker leverage rules, intraday buying power, financing cost)
exposure_semantics.risk_status: RESEARCH ONLY; an M3 PASS is not a live 1.5x leverage approval; Common Risk V1 has no leverage

b1_reproduction: B1 must hash to the committed M1 R1 artifacts (trades and daily returns) before B2 is read
invariants: B1 and B2 have identical universe, H5, selections, entries, exits and standard-PnL trades
delta_t = 0 on every session with multiplier 1.0
B2 session return = 1.5 x B1 session return on every high-breadth session, every scenario

improvement.paired: delta_t = B2 - B1 COST_10BP session return over all 480 sessions; metrics.bootstrap_mean_ci, IID, 10,000 replicates, seed 20260921
improvement.sample_caveat: B2 differs from B1 only on high-breadth sessions (26 expected from the M0 structural count); the count of changed, positive, negative and zero-delta sessions is reported with the p-value

winner.rule: B2 passing every eligibility and improvement condition -> B2 SELECTED; otherwise NO_USEFUL_ENHANCEMENT and B1 carries to M4

m4_authorization.rule: M4 is AUTHORIZED when the configuration carried out of M3 (B2 if selected, else B1) passes every M0 eligibility condition at COST_10BP; otherwise M4 is NOT AUTHORIZED (SKIPPED_NOT_JUSTIFIED)

risk: recovery duration (longest sessions from a peak to a new high, or to the end if never recovered)
diagnostics.stop_b: CAGR ratio B2/B1 vs MDD ratio |B2|/|B1|; flagged when the MDD ratio is larger
diagnostics.blocks: E-D6 four blocks: session mean, trades, compounded return, paired delta
diagnostics.interpretation_limit: the threshold was defined on the 104 broad-coverage sessions and can only fire there; a PASS is a development exploration result for block 4, not a statistically validated E-MAX

reproducibility.required: identical result digest, session exposure map and byte-identical runtime artifacts
